conviction_note: ABOS is a pre-data clinical-stage name, and the stock trades on the ALTITUDE-AD topline, not on the quarter. The trial timeline (enrollment closed 2025-03-26, 80-week double-blind, registry primary completion Oct 2026, 'late 2026' restated on 2026-10-22) says the Oct 26 release very likely carries no data. So the print should be a reiteration plus a going-concern 10-Q, arriving after a ~20% bounce off $1.69. abs_move is 5.0 (median reaction 3.0%, max 11.3%, 80% realised vol, small chance of a timing change) and p_up is 46. The findings sum (-1.1) and the scaled number (-0.4) agree in sign and are both small.

positioning_check: Short interest was 3,079,512 shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 4.80 days to cover (2,804,144 and 8.16 DTC at 09-15; 3,367,011 at 07-31), per https://equibles.com/stocks/abos/shortinterest. On 72,317,285 shares outstanding (10-Q cover, 2026-08-07) that is ~4.3% of shares: not crowded, no squeeze mechanism of note. The option chain is unusable (ATM legs not two-sided), so there is no skew and no implied move. The put/call open-interest ratio is 0.24 on total OI of only 149 contracts (baseline): call-leaning, but too small to say anything. Tape: spot $2.03, +20.1% over 5 sessions (from a mid-October low of ~$1.62-1.69 to $2.06 on 2026-10-22, the day of the CTAD poster release), -9.4% over 20 sessions, -39.8% from the 52-week high. The March 2026 PIPE priced at $3.30.

findings.finding: The Oct 26 print is very unlikely to carry ALTITUDE-AD topline. Enrollment of 542 completed on 2025-03-26 and the double-blind period is 80 weeks (investor-day slide 32). ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06335173 carries an estimated primary completion of 2026-10. On 2026-10-22 the company restated 'topline results are expected in late 2026' and booked only baseline/qualitative posters at CTAD (Nov 16-17). So last-patient-last-visit is around now and data most plausibly lands in Dec 2026. The release should be a reiteration, possibly confirming LPLV or narrowing the month. It arrives after the stock bounced ~20% from ~$1.69 to $2.03 in the week the early report date was announced (Oct 26, against mid-November in prior years).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this name carried a topline-timing change. Its seven 8-K 2.02 reactions were +1.6, -3.5, -3.0, -1.0, -11.3, 0.0, +6.0 (median |3.0|), five of seven flat or down. Q2 2026, a reiteration of 'late 2026', moved +1.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up into the date announcement suggests some holders are positioned for news at the call. Had the market absorbed that the timeline puts topline in December, the stock would not have re-rated 20% on a date notice and a poster release. Upside: the release confirms LPLV and pins a December date. Downside: a bare reiteration, or the window slips toward early 2027, which would collide with the 'into early 2027' runway.
findings.independence: Company release 2026-10-22 restating late-2026 topline and baseline-only CTAD posters: https://www.stocktitan.net/news/ABOS/acumen-pharmaceuticals-to-present-preliminary-baseline-hp5vi1e4200r.html ; investor-day deck 2026-09-16 (80-week DB, 'late 2026', partner if successful): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1576885/000162828026062137/finalinvestordayslides_9.htm ; enrollment completion 2025-03-26: https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/acumen-pharmaceuticals-completes-enrollment-of-altitude-ad-a-phase-2-clinical-trial-of-sabirnetug-acu193-in-early-alzheimers-disease ; price path: https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/548032-why-acumen-pharmaceuticals-inc8217s-abos-stock-is-up-690 . The link from run-up to disappointment is inference, not a document.

findings.finding: The Q3 10-Q will repeat a going-concern paragraph on a shrinking cash pile. Cash was $110.2m at 2026-06-30, H1 operating burn was $42.2m (~$7m/month), and K2 term-loan amortisation takes $10.1m of principal in H2 2026 from 2026-07-01. Sep 30 cash should therefore be roughly $84-88m (estimate), against a ~$147m market cap and runway 'into early 2027'. There were no ATM sales in H1 2026, but a $50m ATM is live, and any post-June ATM use at ~$2 would show in the 10-Q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Going-concern language first appeared in the Q1 2026 10-Q (2026-05-12, -3.5%) and repeated at Q2 (2026-08-12, +1.6%). BofA cut its target from $10 to $9 on the Q2 cash update.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: runway and going-concern are in the last two 10-Qs, and the cash walk is arithmetic anyone can do. The money buys the readout itself (cash covers past topline), so this is not pre-data distress. It is a negative only if the 10-Q shows ATM use or a shorter runway. If it were unpriced, the stock would not trade at ~1.7x estimated cash.
findings.independence: Panabee summary of the Q2 report (going concern, $31.6m loan principal): https://www.panabee.com/news/acumen-pharmaceuticals-earnings-q2-2026-report ; the same 10-Q underlies both, so this is one document.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 missed by $0.05 and the stock rose 1.6%. Q4 2025 beat by $0.09 (MarketBeat 2026-03-26) and the stock fell 3.0%. EPS surprises have not set the sign.

outside_window.finding: ALTITUDE-AD Phase 2 topline (iADRS at 18 months, 542 participants), guided late 2026. This is the event the stock actually trades on, and the timeline points to December 2026.
CTAD 2026 poster session (Nov 16-17): three ALTITUDE-AD posters on baseline characteristics and participant/care-partner interviews, with no efficacy data.
ProMIS PMN310, a competing AbetaO antibody: final 12-month PRECISE-AD Phase 1b topline guided for Q4 2026. A read-across event, undated and most likely after the window.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (unusable chain). The mild negative cuts against the +20% 5-day run-up only in reading that run-up as speculation the release will not satisfy. The -9% 20-day tape, -40% from high and non-crowded short interest give no squeeze reason to shrink it further.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (documents beat inference): the timeline is documentary but the run-up-will-fade link is inference, so finding 1 shrank from -1.0 to -0.8.

Rules 4 and 6 (financing is a question; inside what the company guided): the cash buys the readout and the runway is already guided 'into early 2027', so finding 2 moved toward 0, from -0.5 to -0.3. The going-concern flag keeps its sign negative.
Rule 6 (disputed bar): three EPS sources disagree, so the reported-quarter finding stays capped at 0.
Pessimism artefact: both non-zero findings lean negative into a print with no document saying bad news is coming, so p_up moved from 45 to 46 and expected_move_pct from -0.5 to -0.4.
Rule 7: short interest was checked before the negatives (4.3% of shares, 4.8 DTC). Not crowded, so no further cut.
